title: Step 2 · Choose the install folder
caption: Keep the default folder unless your IT office says otherwise.

marks.label: Install folder
marks.desc: Default: C:\Smart Parking and Vehicle Verification System. Keep the path short: Setup refuses folders longer than 110 characters.

marks.label: Disk space
marks.desc: About 6 GB is needed once the Python environment and application code are downloaded.

marks.label: Back / Next / Cancel
marks.desc: Next continues, Back returns to the previous page, and Cancel quits Setup without installing anything.

patches.text: C:\Smart Parking and Vehicle Verification System
